text: SUPERVISOR — USER RULING on the state-divergence question: OPTION A, AUTO-FLOW. Verbatim: "i just want it to not feel like you cant understand how to do it immediately. i made a voxel shape under the exact same item name so it should carry through to the sculpting." The voxel blockout carries into the SCULPT lens automatically — same item = one shape, zero manual import steps to discover. Design within that: blockout changes re-bake the sculpt base automatically; protect existing sculpt detail sensibly on re-bake (layer sculpt deltas on top if feasible; if a re-bake must invalidate sculpt work, warn at the moment of the voxel edit, not silently). The import-voxel button disappears as a required step (it may remain as an explicit re-bake control only if auto-flow makes it redundant-but-harmless — prefer deleting it). Test: build blockout in VOXEL -> switch to SCULPT -> the blockout IS the sculptable mesh, immediately, no clicks. That immediacy is the PASS.
